executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $242.4 per resident day (44.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $7,971,192 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 18,735 Medicaid days, $425.47 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $408.20 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $456.23 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -10.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $815,569, 13.2% of the $6,181,044 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $941,336, $36.92 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $508,546 (54.0%), allocated fringe $151,795 (16.1%), non-wage costs $280,995 (29.9%). Raw food was $237,078 ($9.3 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $16,742.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $433,767, $17.01 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $310,158 (71.5%), allocated fringe $92,578 (21.3%), non-wage costs $31,031 (7.2%).

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 13 line(s) of the report, a net increase of $111,663 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Building And Building Improvements (page 22 line 7b), added $108,258; Equipment Lease (page 22 line 6e), removed $47,743; Mortgage Expense (page 22 line 8b), added $42,988. Separately, the home itself removed $1,207,117 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
